Practical Training for Students

Practical training lets eligible students gain work experience related to their field of study.

Optional Practical Training

Optional Practical Training (OPT) is temporary employment directly related to the student's major area of study.

When to apply

Students file Form I-765 to request OPT employment authorization from the agency.

  • The application must be filed within the window described by the agency.

  • A recommendation from the Designated School Official is required before filing.

Curricular Practical Training

Curricular Practical Training (CPT) is authorized by the school as part of the curriculum.

Travel

Students traveling abroad should carry a Form I-20 with a recent travel signature from their DSO.
